page.layout: One page of text in a single column; running head at top; catchword "Venit" at lower right corner. No margin notes.

main_text.p: 2 Ad reges quoque qui habitabant ab Aquilone in montanis, & in planitie ad Meridiem Cineroth, & in planitie in Naphoth-Dor ab Occidente.
3 Ad Chananæum ab Oriente & Occidente, & Amorrhæum, & Hittħæum, & Pherisæum, & Iebusæum in montanis, & Hiuæum sub Hermon in terra Mispath.
4 Et egresi sunt ipsi, & omnes exercitus eorū cum ipsis, populus multus tanquam arena quæ est iuxta litus maris, præ multitudine, & equi, & currus multi valde.
5 Congregati sunt omnes reges isti, & venientes castrametati sunt pariter ad aquas Merom, vt pugnarent cum Israele.
6 Dixit autem Iehoua ad Iosuam, Ne timeas à facie eorū: cras enim hoc tempore tradam omnes istos occisos coram Israele, equos eorum subnerues, & curius eorū combures igni.

page.notes: Verse 2 begins "Ad reges" with a small woodcut-like numeral; the word "ab" in line 2 and "Hittæum" are read with some uncertainty; "subneruabis" and "curius" are doubtful readings, the latter likely "currus". Catchword "Venit" belongs to verse 7 on the next page.
